purpose: Use the complete retained F3 debt-securities matrix as an instrument-specific empirical dynamic replay without claiming full-RMD initialization or behavioural closure.

identity.combined_nontransaction_change_semantics: Bookkeeping residual equal to revaluations plus other changes in volume at the retained bilateral F3 boundary. It is not decomposed or interpreted causally.
methodological_basis: ESA 2010 financial balance-sheet identity: closing positions differ from opening positions through financial transactions and other flows.
Other flows comprise revaluations and other changes in volume.

required_checks: all 70 source series required by canonical F3 stock/transaction cell terms are AVAILABLE for 2025-Q1..Q4
all 35 in-boundary F3 cells are finite for stock and transaction in each retained quarter
every Q2-Q4 cell transition closes exactly at published two-decimal precision
Q4 replay closing stocks reproduce the canonical F3 stock benchmark
Q1-Q4 transaction sums reproduce the canonical 2025 F3 flow benchmark
double-entry system net financial worth remains zero for every replayed quarterly state
no non-F3 instrument is initialized or changed
